content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate observed for POST /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. Spike started ~3778882200. Error class: gateway timeout (504) and 502 bursts. Summary: 1500 errors/min over last 3m. Runbook: /runbooks/gateway-timeouts. Paging oncall.

sre-oncall: oncall here, thanks. I'll take lead. starting retention of logs and trace bundle.

alex: seeing same in dashboards — CPU on gw-proxy nodes at 85% and upstream gateway retries spiking. adding to timeline.

maria: customer-impact: Support flagged 8 customers with degraded responses (timeouts), one with SLA alert. Support ticket ids: CS-9123, CS-9127.

kevin: quick hypothesis: upstream service mysrv-auth is returning 502 which cascades to gateway and triggers retries => amplification. need correlation ids.

alex: pulled a sample request with corrid 0a1b2c3d-9f7e-4a1b-99c2-xyz789. raw proxy log snippet: ```[2026-03-10T14:17:42Z] corrid=0a1b2c3d method=POST path=/v1/generate status=504 upstream_status=502 retry_count=3 backend=mysrv-auth node=gw-12```

maria: support-bot posted customer error logs link: https://logshare.internal/r/CS-9123/3778882345 (access granted to incident channel).

sre-oncall: mitigation actions: 1) temporarily disable automatic gateway retry policy for /v1/generate 2) increase proxy upstream timeout from 2s -> 6s for prod-us-east-1 3) scale gw-proxy pool +2 instances. Applying now. Will update when changes roll.

alex: logs show many retries back-to-back. If retry_count > 1 within 100ms windows, we get thundering retries. Suggest reducing client retry to single attempt and relying on circuit-breaker.

kevin: pulling KV trace bundle and aggregated traces for corrid list. uploading to /tmp/tracebundle-3778882345.tar.gz and pushing to logstore.

sre-oncall: applied timeout change and disabled retrier at 14:22:10Z — observing error rate drop in next 60s. Monitoring.

incident-bot: deployment note: config-change by sre-oncall at 14:22:10Z - gatekeeper accepted.

maria: customer update: posted to affected customers that we're investigating and applied mitigation. CS updated tickets. :thumbsup:

alex: attaching query I used to find corrids (for others): ```kql
logs | where path == "/v1/generate" and status in (502,504) | summarize count() by corrid, upstream_status | sort by count_desc
```

kevin: trace bundle uploaded: https://tracebox.internal/bundles/3778882345 — includes kv logs, proxy metrics, and 10 full traces. Corrids of interest: 0a1b2c3d-9f7e, 1b2c3d4e-8f9a, 7f6e5d4c-3b2a.

sre-oncall: current status: error rate dropped ~70% vs peak, customer-impact reduced. Keeping channel open for 30m to verify stability. Assigning RCA lead: alex. Hypotheses to track in RCA: 1) upstream service mysrv-auth returning intermittent 502s under load; 2) gateway retry policy amplifies errors; 3) kernel-level socket exhaustion on gw-proxy under retry storm.

alex: I'll collect upstream service logs and replication steps. Will start timeline: pre-spike CPU/rt, retry counts, config changes, and client-side load patterns.

maria: support will prepare customer impact timeline and list of affected orgs for postmortem.

kevin: quick note for post-incident: capture kernel fd usage on gw nodes and enable per-node backoff. Also recommend adding per-route retry cap.

sre-oncall: agreed. Next steps: assemble timeline (alex), gather traces/logs (kevin), customer impact (maria). We'll create follow-up incident doc and link here when ready.

support-bot: auto-created incident doc: https://confluence.internal/incidents/3778882345 (editable by #incidents).

sre-oncall: thanks team — leaving open for another 30m then will close with mitigation status. If error rate creeps back up, we'll re-escalate. :white_check_mark:
